comment: Mark sits in the merged band where run4's rising solid line (u 2075-2130) covers run10 and run12, so run10 ink cannot be followed at the mark. Visible run10 dots are lower at u 1986-2046 (v~1917, ~27 lb) and level at u 2138-2310 (v~1908, ~31 lb): run10 rises from a shallow minimum into a flat plateau that runs to the end of the record. No crest above the plateau is visible; at most a knee.

Mark is on run12 ink at the grid crossing (line center u~974 at v 1867). Steep fall (du/dv ~0.25 above v 1830) bends to du/dv ~0.85 (v 1889-1925); tangents meet near (965,1861), curve point ~(971,1862), about 5 px from the mark. Bend visible on the 4x crop.

Both on ink: the apex cap of run12 spans v 549-575 (u 766-782). P (772,557) is on the upper cap near where the two legs' centerlines meet (~v 559); Q's cap samples (769,572) and (780,573) are on the lower part of the same cap, so Q's trace cuts the apex about 13 px low.
(1098,1964) on the run12 dash at u 1080-1113 (v 1958-1969 at that column, crossing a grid line); (1158,1977) on the long dash, column ink v 1973-1981.
(1217,1970) on the dash where it crosses the vertical grid line (dash v 1964-1976); (1279,1944) on the dash, column ink v 1938-1951.
(1340,1903) on the short run12 dash (u ~1324-1362) where it crosses the vertical grid line; dash spans about v 1897-1910 there.
(1460,1838) on the run12 long dash (v 1833-1843 at u 1458-1463) where it crosses the vertical grid line; run10 dots are well above.
(1522,1835) on the run12 dash, column ink v 1830-1840.
(1583,1850) on the short run12 dash (u ~1572-1612, about v 1845-1856 at this column), at the vertical grid line.
(1643,1871) on the run12 dash just below the 50 lb grid line; dash ink v ~1865-1876 at u 1643.
(1704,1892) on the run12 long dash (about v 1887-1899) where it crosses the vertical grid line.
(1766,1912) on the run12 long dash, column ink v 1907-1918.
Short dash spans u 1831-1870, v 1913-1927. (1835,1920) is on it; (1870,1918) is on its last column (ink v 1916-1922). The blob just right of it at u 1871-1879, v 1905-1915 is a run10 dot.

Both on the straight top stroke of the bundle (v ~1899-1912, u ~1915-2071). Told apart: the bundle's thick lower curve is run4 (continuous with its steep descent and with its rise to 50 lb), the row of dots between them at v~1917 with 17 px spacing is run10, and the continuous top stroke fits run12's long-dash cadence (long 1630-1810, short 1831-1870, long ~1890-2071).

Run12's long dash runs into the vertical grid line (u 2072-2076); its last visible column is u 2071 (v 1901-1904) and no dash ink appears right of the grid line (at u 2077 ink starts at v 1904, run4's band). The sample sits at the grid line's center, 3 px past the last dash ink, beyond the 2 px allowed by convention 2; it also touches run4's band.

(2135,1916) is on the tail of the short run12 dash visible below run4's band at u 2131-2136, v 1913-1918 (run12 height; run10 dots sit higher at v 1902-1912). (2197,1918) is on the long dash (v 1913-1924) at the grid line.
(2258,1919) on the run12 long dash (v 1913-1925); run10 dots sit on top of it at v 1905-1912.

Off: (1890,1911). It sits on a round run10 dot (u 1884-1894, v 1905-1915, on the 17 px dot sequence that reaches the dots at u 1989-2041) in the gap after run12's short dash ends at u 1870; no run12 ink within 2 px (u 1891-1894 shows only a 4 px bridge). On: (1949,1908), on the bundle's top stroke (run12) at the grid line.

Mark on run4 ink (center ~1754 at u 1016). Slope changes from dv/du ~-0.55 (u 930-1004) to ~-0.22 (u 1040-1108) where run10's dots cross; tangents meet near (1023,1748), curve point ~(1022,1751), about 7 px from the mark, close to the 8 px limit.

Mark is on run4 ink, but the line runs straight there (du/dv ~0.45-0.55 from v 1715 to 1850). The rounding from the plateau into the steep fall ends near (1795,1712), about 45 px above; no direction change at the mark on the 4x crop.

Mark on run4 ink on the steep fall. The slope eases progressively (du/dv 0.46 above v 1858, 0.8 at 1866-1886, 1.1 at 1886-1904) into the flat minimum; the steep-to-flat corner is near (1893-1905, 1915-1929), about 40 px away, and the onset of flattening near (1864,1860) is about 19 px away.

Mark on run4 ink (center ~1874 at u 2203). Rise slope dv/du ~-0.24 (u 2150-2200) flattens to ~-0.05 (u 2200-2280); tangents meet near (2206,1873), about 3 px from the mark; the bend is visible on the 4x crop at the vertical grid line.

Mark is on a run10 dot (u 1331-1341, v 2788-2799). The leveling is a long smooth arc (slope -0.6 at u 1106-1162 easing to 0 by u 1500) with no distinct corner; the knee by tangent intersection and by maximum departure from the chord lies near (1290-1305, 2801-2805), 35-50 px left of the mark.

The sample is the axis origin inside the frame corner: 1-2 px inside the left frame line (u 744-750) and in the top row of the bottom frame (v 3269-3277). Nearest curve ink outside the frame is about (751,3268), roughly 3 px away, beyond the 2 px allowed by convention 2; runs 4, 10 and 12 are also merged there. Borderline call.
(1110,2894) on the run10 dot at u 1101-1112 (merged with the vertical grid line); (1174,2856) on the edge of the dot at u 1173-1183, v 2846-2857.

(1340,2792) on the dot at u 1331-1341; (1352,2789) on the dot bulging on both sides of the vertical grid line (u 1348-1357, v ~2785-2796); (1417,2785) on the left edge of the dot at u 1417-1426, v 2777-2787.

P (751,3236) is on a run10 dot pressed against the left frame (u 750-760, v 3228-3243), 0.14 in up, not where a line starts. Q (857,3134) is where run12 first shows as a separate dash. Run12 can be followed into the bundle by its dash cadence: a short dash on the bundle's right side (u 820-844, v 3133-3178), a gap, then a continuous right-edge stroke from (805,3190) to the bottom frame. First point would be about (760,3267). If the bundle is not credited to run12, Q is the first identifiable run12 ink.

Mark is on ink, 9 px in from the lower-left end of run12's first separate dash (starts u 855), where the dash runs straight (dv/du ~-0.5 from u 856 to 900). The turn from the steep shared rise into this dash has its corner near (838,3139), across the dash gap, about 27 px away; the next gentle bend (to ~-0.28) is near (908,3105).

Mark on run12 ink (column v 3034-3045). Slope changes from ~-0.16 (u 1120-1196) to ~-0.23 (u 1208-1450) at the dash gap near u 1200, where the next dash starts ~2 px higher; that corner is about (1200,3045), ~25 px left. The dash through the mark is straight on the 4x crop.

Mark on run12 ink, but the line is flat there (v 2960-2970 from u 1652 on). The leveling from slope ~-0.12 (u 1500-1556) to flat has its tangent corner near (1632,2965), about 35 px left; the remaining 1-2 px drift at u 1644-1676 is too small to see on a 4x crop.
(2337,2962) is on the last full column of run12's final dash (u 2337, v 2957-2967); ink stops at u 2338.

The seven samples follow the bundle's dotted left fringe; (751,3236) and (808,3171) sit on isolated run10 dots (u 750-760, v 3228-3243; u 801-810, v 3166-3177), the rest on the left part of the merged band. The only run12-like dash ink in the bundle is on its right side (short dash u 820-844, v 3133-3178; right-edge stroke from (805,3190) down), 4-15 px from these samples.

Mark on run4 ink, but the line is straight there: du/dv ~0.68-0.70 from v 2930 up to v 2700. Curvature begins above; tangents of the straight part and of the part above v 2670 meet near (1150,2664), about 58 px away.

Same position as item 024: the axis origin inside the frame corner, 1-2 px into the left frame (u 744-750) and in the top row of the bottom frame (v 3269-3277). Nearest curve ink outside the frame is about (751,3268), roughly 3 px away, beyond 2 px; run4 cannot be told from runs 10 and 12 there. Borderline call.
(2319,2260) is on the last column of run4 before it runs into the 140 ms vertical grid line (u 2320-2323); line ink v 2254-2265; no ink beyond the grid line.

Mark is on a run10 dot partly behind the vertical grid line (u 1812-1821, v 3208-3221 incl. bulge). Dots run at dv/du ~-0.9 up to u 1809, then ~-2 above; tangents meet near (1816,3224), curve corner ~(1812,3220), about 6 px from the mark; bend visible on the 4x crop.

Mark is on a run10 dot (u 2084-2095, v 2569-2580), but on the start of the unloading run. The 90 degree turn from the near-vertical rise (u ~2064) into unloading is centered on the dot at (2073,2582); tangents meet near (2064,2579). The mark is 15-20 px past the corner.
(1913,3059) on the run10 dot at u 1907-1918, v 3053-3067; (1967,2993) on the dot at u 1963-1972, v 2987-2999, where the vertical grid line is broken (the dot fits the 17 px dot spacing).

Near the origin the three runs merge into one stroke along the bottom frame (curve ink about v 3789-3795, frame below to 3804). The sample is directly under that stroke, about 2 px below its visible lower edge, 10 px from the right frame. Run10's dots join this stroke from above near u 2150-2230; runs cannot be separated here.

(2085,2811) and (2084,2808) are on the top run10 dot below the blank strip (u 2082-2091, v 2808-2820); (2064,2612) is on the bottom run10 dot above the strip (u 2060-2068, v 2604-2615), part of the dot column at u~2064.
(2187,2557) is on run10's last dot (u 2183-2193, v 2552-2564), which touches the 2.0 in grid line; no further run10 dots to the right.

Mark is at the lower-left corner of the dash that starts at u 598 (dash v 3501-3506 plus grid row 3507). Slope changes from dv/du ~-0.44 (u 462-576) to ~-0.28 (u 600-636) across the white gap at the grid crossing (u 583-597); tangents meet near (603,3501), about 7 px from the mark. The change is about 8 degrees, faint on a 4x crop.

Mark on run12 ink near a dash end, but the line is straight across the 4x crop (dv/du ~-0.055 at u 1252-1372). The change from ~-0.125 (u 820-1204) to ~-0.05 (u 1404-1580) is gradual; tangent corner near (1255,3404), about 57 px left.

Mark on the right end of run12 dash D3 (u 2105-2165), which runs straight at dv/du ~0.3. The steepening from the previous dash (u 2185-2218, dv/du ~0.7) has its corner in the dash gap near (2178,3129), about 17 px away.
(743,3680) on the run12 long dash just right of the vertical grid line; column ink v 3675-3684.
(456,3569) on the outgoing dash at the crest (u 453 on, v 3564-3576); (571,3514) on the same dash near its upper end, column ink present.
(2191,3304) on the dash rising from u 2185 to 2244; (2252,3283) on the lower end of the near-vertical dash (u 2248-2256, ink to v 3289).
(2234,3181) on the near-vertical run12 dash where it crosses the horizontal grid line (dash ink above at v 3169-3177 and below at 3184 on, center u ~2233 at this height).
(2121,3112) on dash D3 where it crosses the vertical grid line; dash ink v ~3107-3117 on both sides.

All three are on the lower edge of run12's ink where its dashes lie along the bottom frame (frame top about v 3798 at u 1950-2160): (1979,3798) and (2134,3797) within 0-2 px of dash ink at v 3787-3797; (2277,3797) is under the shared stroke at the origin. The other reader sits at the dash center (v 3791-3793).
(555,3632) on the last column of the short run12 dash (u 515-555, v 3609-3633); (454,3574) on the crest tip ink.
(2251,3242) and (2235,3184) both on the near-vertical run12 dash (u ~2225-2256, v 3169-3289).
(2085,3060) on run12's curved dash where it turns up (left of the vertical grid line); run4 is farther left.

Rounded corner of run4 runs from about (1820,1285) to (1865,1237); vertical part at u 1819.5, unloading run at v ~1235. P (1830,1250) is ~3 px from the corner point (1833,1249); Q (1855,1237) is on the arc's tail ~25 px along, direction about 7-10 degrees from the straight run, not clearly on the straight part. P is the closer one.

Mark on run4 ink at the lower edge of the scan break (no ink at v 2665-2697). The slope eases gradually from about -0.33 (v 2850-2780) to about -0.1 (above v 2730); tangent corner near (1965,2748), about 43 px below the mark; the line runs straight through the mark and the break.

P (2189,1252) is at the hook tip (ink to u 2193). Q's samples are all on ink too: (2092,1229) and (2138,1227) on the outgoing upper stroke, (2113,1254) on the returning lower stroke, (2186,1254) at the tip. Q's polyline zigzags across the white gap between the two strokes.

Q (2110,1252) is on the returning lower stroke near its left end (stroke u 2108-2193, v 1247-1258). P's four samples are all on ink but alternate between the upper and lower strokes, so P's polyline crosses the white gap.

Same situation as item 039: the sample is directly under the shared stroke of runs 4, 10 and 12 along the bottom frame near the origin, about 2 px below the visible curve ink (v ~3789-3795); run4 descends into this stroke near u 2200-2230; runs cannot be separated here.
(2138,1227) is on the outgoing upper stroke just before it bends down to the hook tip. It does not extend the curve past its drawn end, which is the left end of the returning stroke near (2108,1252).
